parameters.content:
## 👉 START HERE
1. Open **1. Brand Inputs (EDIT ME)** and fill in the brand.
2. Add your free Gemini key to the 3 **Gemini** nodes (one credential, reused).
3. Click **Execute workflow**. Takes 1–3 minutes.
4. Open **19. Report File**, click **Download**.

## PART 1 · Site-wide checks (code, no AI)
Reads the files every search engine and AI crawler reads first: **robots.txt** (who is allowed in), **sitemap.xml** (list of pages), **llms.txt** (unproven, info only), the **homepage**, and Google **PageSpeed** on mobile. Missing files do not stop the flow.

## PART 2 · Page facts (code, no AI)
Picks up to *maxPages* pages (homepage → its menu links → sitemap), downloads each one, and writes down facts: status, title, H1, word count, noindex, canonical, schema, question headings, alt text.
**11** applies fixed rules and gives each issue a starting severity.

**Why code here? Code cannot hallucinate.**

## PART 3 · AI + your judgment
**12 Auditor** ranks the issues and names the noise → **13 YOU** correct it → **14 Strategist** turns audit + customer questions into a content plan → **15 Translator** rewrites it for the business owner.
Each AI step has one job and its own prompt. Swap Gemini for Claude or OpenAI by changing the model node.

## PART 4 · Report
Combines everything into one web page: owner summary first, then audit, your notes, strategy and the raw facts as proof.
